s: a town and rural district of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Soest.et: From Middle Low German Sôest, Old Saxon Sōsat. The -e- indicates vowel length (as e.g. in Coesfeld, Oer). Very old place name derived from the root of Proto-Indo-European *sed- (“to sit”).
